notes.title: The Story
notes.notes:
Thousands of years ago, an alien specie known to mankind as the "Dragoon Goddess" inhabited earth with her 3 offsprings, unhatched eggs which requires millennials to hatch. 

The first men, the Urmo Tribe, worshiped this Goddess and built her a temple. In turn the Goddess blessed the land with life - trees, food, and animals.

Thousands of years have passed and so have the tribe and the existence of this Goddess. In 1900, the Blackrock Miners Inc claimed the resource rich land, mining the ores and tearing down the trees. However one day the men mysteriously disappeared and no one came there since, believing it is haunted.

As the world is becoming more transparent with new technology, old mysteries are starting to unravel as well, sometimes with dire consequences. It is 2040, and you are an agent part of an organization to explore these deep mystery of the past.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26948281/8b9fc61bfbc00544bc5ce17e737ffc6cb984f386.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Creation of EN-59
notes.notes:
We know you all have been waiting for the release of Unearthed Inc. Let us first introduce EN-59, your sidekick assistant for your mission.

EN-59 is a flying self-aware Droid with a British accent and a sarcastic personality. He flies around with you and help you solve your case.

This is the first concept of EN-59. We want to make it a flying droid so it can explore the region freely.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26948281/e5c80be3f1a88a1a097a00a0d7d76691bdf88be3.jpg[/img]

Then we try to give it hands. It looks smarter, doesn't it?
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26948281/1ee41936a414fa0fa24680643edea3982d3d3227.jpg[/img]

Let's see what it looks like when it becomes 3D.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26948281/2e3a9dc111a20af759edc1906ebee0147d521849.jpg[/img]

Finally EM-59 is ready for the mission!
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26948281/6b955ddf9b46c325405a657f327ac469618dd43f.jpg[/img]

EM-59 can do various things. It can scan the environment and let you know what is happening when you arrive to a new place. It will also give you useful hints for your mission! So remember to treat him nicely and don't do naughty things like this!
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26948281/c238e7617c4f54d60c4dc82959da86b4cc33395c.gif[/img]
